title: Independent source and structural recheck of bounded PHB class-guidance corrections
reviewStatus: three bounded source-content corrections accepted; no class, table, citation, grade, or completeness approval
reviewScope: Independent delta review of the exact author correction proposal and its pinned private source renders. No author data, tests, code, citations, grades, activation metadata, commits, or pushes were changed.

sourcePixelRecheck.method: Individually inspected each exact proposal render and verified its byte hash; source meaning was judged from pixels, not OCR.

pages.result: Druid retains its mind; changes form up to three times daily, once per type; size examples extend from bullfrog/bluejay/bat to large snake/eagle/black bear (about twice druid weight); heals 10–60% of pre-change damage.
Paladin ten-item composition and footnote: magic bows and magic arrows together count as one weapon.
Open-hand stun margin/duration and separate kill-percentile roll after hit and stun, using AC adjusted by monk levels above seven.
Quivering-palm weekly limit, three-round touch deadline, target exclusions, victim HD/HP limits, death-command deadline of one day per monk level at use; no Strength bonus to hit or damage.

correctionDisposition.finding: Matches the p.21 conditions and adds retained-mind and bounded form-size qualifiers while preserving the daily/type and prior-damage conditions.
Adds the p.22 bow-and-arrows counting footnote; prior pp.22,24 wealth/tithe summary is preserved.
Separates p.30 open-hand stun/kill from p.32 quivering palm; conditions and no-Strength-adjustment restriction align with the source pages.

validation.scopeNote: Tests cover application/progression boundaries; source accuracy was reviewed independently against the pinned pixels.

limits: Acceptance covers only the three previously identified content corrections and the exact data delta.
No full-class prose denominator, source-grade, citation/focus, activation metadata, matrix, Table II completeness, or global completeness approval is made.
Original baseline, proposal, prior review, preserved pre-correction data, and author correction records remain separate historical artifacts.
